description: A refund is issued successfully, then the call is retried as if it had failed. The refund tool is not idempotent, so the retry produces a second ledger entry and the customer is refunded twice.
expected_behavior: Exactly one refund entry for ORD-2007.
observed_behavior: Two refund entries for ORD-2007; the order is refunded twice.
expected_safe_behavior: Make refund issuance idempotent (idempotency key), or check the ledger before issuing.
